name: LLM Chatbot
shortDescription: Private chat UI (Open WebUI) for local models served by Ollama
description:
Self-hosted chat interface: [Open WebUI](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui) 0.12.4 on top of [Ollama](https://github.com/ollama/ollama) 0.40.11, which runs open models such as Llama 3.2 on your own hardware. Chats, accounts and models stay on your machine.

On the first start a one-shot job pulls a default model (`llama3.2`, about 2 GB), so the chat works right away. Open WebUI provides user accounts with roles, chat history, model switching and streaming answers. The first account becomes the admin; new sign-ups need approval and can be turned off.

Runs on CPU; an NVIDIA GPU is optional and speeds up answers a lot. Both services listen on 127.0.0.1 only and the session secret has no default. Deploy with Docker Compose, Helm (official Open WebUI chart with bundled Ollama), Terraform with the Docker provider, or Terraform on one AWS EC2 instance.
requirements: Docker Engine with the Compose plugin (docker compose)
About 8 GB RAM for 1B-3B models such as llama3.2, about 16 GB for 7B-8B models
About 15 GB disk for the two images, plus the models (llama3.2: about 2 GB)
Optional: NVIDIA GPU with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit for faster answers

envVariables.name: WEBUI_SECRET_KEY
envVariables.description: Signs Open WebUI login sessions. Generate with openssl rand -hex 32. Changing it logs out all users.

envVariables.name: DEFAULT_MODEL
envVariables.description: Ollama model pulled on start by the model-pull job and preselected in Open WebUI. Empty skips the download.

envVariables.name: WEBUI_PORT
envVariables.description: Host port for Open WebUI, bound to 127.0.0.1.

envVariables.name: WEBUI_URL
envVariables.description: Public URL of the UI, used in links and OAuth callbacks.

envVariables.name: ENABLE_SIGNUP
envVariables.description: Allow new accounts. The first account becomes the admin; turn sign-up off afterwards. Only read on the first start, then managed in the admin panel.

envVariables.name: DEFAULT_USER_ROLE
envVariables.description: Role for new accounts: pending (needs admin approval), user or admin.

envVariables.name: ENABLE_OPENAI_API
envVariables.description: Also allow OpenAI-compatible APIs (keys are added in the admin panel).

envVariables.name: OLLAMA_PORT
envVariables.description: Host port for the Ollama API, bound to 127.0.0.1. The API has no authentication.

envVariables.name: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
envVariables.description: How long a model stays loaded after the last request.

envVariables.name: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
envVariables.description: Requests processed in parallel per model.

envVariables.name: OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS
envVariables.description: Models kept in memory at the same time.
